notes: No source found reports ACNR's injury rate (11.10 per 100 workers a year, 2018-24) or ranks coal owners by injury rate; searches for company-level rankings returned only MSHA/NIOSH aggregate tables. ACNR coverage found is about single deaths and injuries (April 2026 Ohio County Mine death, January 2026 Marshall County injury) and citation counts. Foresight Energy's own site calls its mines among the safest; not recorded since Foresight isn't the headline entity. An NBC 2007 story on Murray Energy mine injury rates predates the window and the ACNR name, not opened.
